verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
AMAZE-omulimu gwe
Alwanye-olutalo lwe;
Avudde mu mayengo,
Yeesiimye-okuwunguka.
Kitaffe tuwaayo gy'oli,
Omwana w(o) eyeebase

verse.name: v2
v3
verse.lines:
Eyo-amaanyi g'okufa
Tegakyamutuutako;
Omununuzi gy'ali
Eyawangula-okufa
Kitaffe tuwaayo gy'oli,
Omwana w(o) eyeebase

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Naffe-abasigaddewo
Tulinda nnyo n'essuubi;
Okumulaba Yesu,
Ku lunaku-olwentiisa.
Kitaffe tuwaayo gy'oli,
Omwana w(o) eyeebase
